# Detailed Report: `r y`

```{r}
df_mini <- df |>
  dplyr::filter(year == y)

total_hours  <- sum(df_mini$`Learning hours`, na.rm = TRUE)
n_categories <- length(unique(df_mini$`Activity type`))
```

In `r y` I completed `r total_hours` hours of CPD training, across `r n_categories` categories.

```{r}
df_mini |>
  dplyr::group_by(`Activity type`) |>
  dplyr::summarise(total_hours = sum(`Learning hours`, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(total_hours)) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::cols_label(
    `Activity type` = gt::md("**Activity Type**"),
    total_hours     = gt::md("**Learning Hours**")
  ) |>
  gt::grand_summary_rows(
    columns = c(total_hours),
    fns = list(Total = ~ sum(.)),
    fmt = ~ gt::fmt_number(., use_seps = FALSE)
  )
```

## Benefits Gained

```{r}
df_mini |>
  dplyr::select(Title, `Learning hours`, Description, `Benefit to practice`, `Benefit to users`) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::tab_options(table.width = gt::pct(100)) |>
  gt::cols_label(
    Title                 = gt::md("**Title**"),
    `Learning hours`      = gt::md("**Learning Hours**"),
    Description           = gt::md("**Description**"),
    `Benefit to practice` = gt::md("**Benefit to Practice**"),
    `Benefit to users`    = gt::md("**Benefit to Users**")
  ) |>
  gt::cols_width(
    Title                 ~ gt::px(80),
    `Learning hours`      ~ gt::px(80),
    Description           ~ gt::px(150),
    `Benefit to practice` ~ gt::px(245),
    `Benefit to users`    ~ gt::px(245)
  ) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style     = gt::cell_text(size = gt::px(11)),
    locations = gt::cells_body(columns = dplyr::everything())
  )
```
